content.title: Denver Nuggets vs Phoenix Suns Nov 29, 2025 Game Summary
content.text: Saturday, November 29th, 2025 11:31 PMBy DAVID BRANDT - AP Sports WriterGame RecapPHOENIX (AP) Nikola Jokic scored 26 points, Jamal Murray added 24 and the Denver Nuggets pulled away late to beat the Phoenix Suns 130-112 on Saturday night.The hot-shooting Nuggets made 22 of 38 3-pointers (57.9%) - hitting 10 in the first half and 12 in the second for a steady stream of offense. Tim Hardaway Jr. scored 23 points off the bench and was 7 of 11 from behind the arc.Jokic - who barely played in the fourth quarter - was 7 of 7 from the field and added 10 assists and nine rebounds to finish just shy of his 11th triple-double this season.Denver pushed its lead to 96-85 entering the fourth quarter after hitting eight 3-pointers in the third. The Suns cut the deficit to nine early in the fourth but the Nuggets responded with the next 12 points to build a comfortable 110-89 advantage.The Nuggets bounced back from Friday night's loss to the San Antonio Spurs. The Suns have lost three of four.Dillon Brooks led the Suns with 27 points on 10-of-18 shooting. Devin Booker scored 24, making 14 of 15 free throws.The Nuggets had a 63-60 lead at halftime after shooting 10 of 16 (62.5%) from 3-point range. Jokic had 18 points and Hardaway added 17. Brooks led the Suns with 19.Suns guard Grayson Allen returned after missing more than two weeks with a bruised quadriceps. He finished with 10 points.Nuggets: Host the Dallas Mavericks on Monday.Suns: At the Los Angeles Lakers on Monday.---AP NBA: https://apnews.com/hub/NBAActivate NBA League Pass to watch games live and on demand.GAME INFOSunday, November 30, 20252:00 AMMortgage Matchup CenterPhoenix, AZOfficialsPat Fraher, Phenizee Ransom, Danielle ScottLINESCORESTeamQ1Q2Q3Q4FinalDEN30333334130PHX25352527112TeamPITPFB PTSBIG LDBPTSTREBTOVTTOVPOTDEN429213881617PHX421782897023
